mechanism.claim: Within a volatile completed BTC block, the direction whose squared-return energy has a materially later time centroid is the direction in which price discovery is migrating. Follow that late-arriving directional energy for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of positive-return variation centroid minus negative-return variation centroid
mechanism.why_distinct: Semivariance imbalance compares total positive versus negative squared mass; temporal variance ignition compares unsigned energy in fixed halves; turnover-variation lag compares activity and unsigned variation centroids. HVDVTM compares continuous time centroids of positive and negative squared-return energy, with no endpoint gate, volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-asset, prior event, fitted outcome, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed total variation must rank in its causal upper 35% while directional energy timing separation enters its upper 30%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily signed variation-centroid migration onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.time_coordinate: minute index divided by 479, from zero through one
features.positive_variation_centroid: sum(time*r^2 for r>0)/sum(r^2 for r>0), strict positive denominator
features.negative_variation_centroid: sum(time*r^2 for r<0)/sum(r^2 for r<0), strict positive denominator
features.directional_timing_contrast: positive centroid minus negative centroid, finite strict nonzero
features.timing_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(directional_timing_contrast) over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared minute returns), finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: relative arrival time of positive and negative squared-return energy

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no energy definition, centroid, rank, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
